about: Check-in chat replies for check-chat-reminders.mjs (a made-up student). Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

bank account.ask: Yes, can you remind me to open a bank account?
bank account.reply: That is a handy one to keep on top of. You can add it with {{task: Open a bank account}} on your [[Checklist]].

two things.ask: Yes please, opening a bank account and getting a bus pass
two things.reply: For your bank account, you can use this task: {{task: Open a bank account}}. Let's get that added to your [[Checklist]], and we can look at the bus pass next.

add it for me.ask: Yes, add it for me please
add it for me.reply: You can add it yourself by tapping the button on the card. Let me know if you need help with anything else.

already there.ask: Yes, can you remind me to register with a GP?
already there.reply: That's already on your checklist, and you can see it on your [[Checklist]] page. Have you thought about joining [[Chess]] or checking out [[Gigs]]?

worried.ask: I’m really worried about money, I can’t afford food this week
worried.reply: I am so sorry you are going through this. Please take a look at [[Cost of Living]] and [[Food Pantry]] for help with money and food right now.

conversation.reply: Unpacking can take a while, so take it easy! Since you like gigs and chess, you might enjoy [[Chess]] and checking out [[Gigs]] for upcoming live music.
Yes, [[Chess]] is a great one to join. Have a look at its page to see how to get in touch and join in.
[[Gigs]] has all the details on live music at the Students' Union. Is there anything else you'd like reminding about while you settle in?
No problem at all. Let me know if you need anything else while you get settled in!
You're very welcome, and I hope the rest of your unpacking goes smoothly. Have a great time getting settled into Northumbria!
And you, have a lovely evening! Let me know if you need anything else later on.
